The General Studies and Mental Ability paper is set in English and translated into Telugu; the English version is authentic. Subject papers are in English only. If the Computer Based Tests are held in multiple sessions, the Commission will normalise scores and announce results on a percentile basis. The test is held at four centres: Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Tirupathi and Ananthapuramu. how_to_apply: Log in to the Commission's website https://psc.ap.gov.in with the registered OTPR ID/number and password. First-time applicants for any APPSC notification must first fill the One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) to obtain an OTPR ID; the user ID is sent to the registered mobile number and email ID.
After login, click "Online Application Submission" in the bottom right corner of the website.
Click the "Fill Application" button against Notification No. 29/2026.
Check the OTPR data, then fill application-specific data such as Local/Non-Local status and White card details, which are also used to calculate the fee.

Fill qualification details, post preferences and examination centre, then click "Save & Submit". Saving alone does not submit the application, and the payment link is generated only after "Save & Submit".
Pay the fee through the payment gateway. On successful payment the application is finally submitted, a payment reference ID is generated and an SMS is sent to the registered mobile number.
Download the filled application PDF for reference. If payment fails, start a fresh payment process as described in Step II of the notice.

OTPR registration alone is not an application for any post. Data from OTPR at the time of submission is the data considered for this notification; later OTPR changes are not considered. A general Mock Test is available under the MOCK TEST option on the main page of the website.
important_instructions: Applications sent by any mode other than the prescribed online mode will not be entertained. Candidates must visit the Commission's website regularly until the recruitment process is complete; the website information is final for all correspondence. Hall tickets will be hosted on the website. There is no waiting list; recruitment is made only to the notified vacancies. A BC candidate who cannot produce the Non-Creamy Layer certificate on the day of verification is not entitled to the benefit of reservation. Persons in Government service, autonomous bodies or aided institutions must inform their Head of Office in writing that they have applied. Incorrect or false information can lead to rejection at any stage and debarment up to five years from the Commission's examinations. Candidates who canvass or enlist extraneous support for their candidature are disqualified. Mobile phones (even switched off), calculators, smart watches and other electronic devices are banned in the examination. The Commission may alter the terms and conditions, including vacancies, or withdraw the notification.

content_sections.text: This is Notification No. 29/2026 (General Recruitment) for direct recruitment to one post, Deputy Commissioner of Endowments, in the A.P. rows.details: Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Vijayawada
Direct Recruitment to the post of Deputy Commissioner of Endowments in A.P. Charitable and Hindu Religious Institutions and Endowments Service (General Recruitment)

content_sections.heading: About APPSC
content_sections.text: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission conducts recruitment and selection for State posts, with its office in Vijayawada. The notice states that the Commission acts under Articles 315 to 320 of the Constitution of India and follows the principle of order of merit. The post in this notification serves the Endowments Service for A.P. charitable and Hindu religious institutions.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must hold the educational qualification as on the date of the detailed notification. The date of this notification, 27-11-2026, is the crucial date for calculating the experience, including practical experience. Other conditions in the notice: Candidates must profess the Hindu religion and shall cease to hold the post when they cease to profess it, as per Rule-13 of the Special Service Rules issued in G.O.Ms.No.245 Revenue (Endowments-I) Dept., dated 08.05.2002. Candidates belonging to BC-C and BC-E Communities are not eligible for this post. The candidate must be of sound health, active habits and free from any bodily defect or infirmity rendering him or her unfit for the service. Character and antecedents must be such as to qualify the candidate for the service. The candidate must be a citizen of India. A non-citizen may be appointed only with the previous sanction of the State Government. The Rule of Local Reservation is not applicable as the post is State Cadre. Degrees obtained through Open Universities or Distance Education must be recognised by the Distance Education Council, Government of India. Candidates should read the official notification for the full eligibility rules.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on merit in the Written Examination, subject to the candidate qualifying the Computer Proficiency Test (CPT). Appointment is subject to medical fitness. Written Examination: objective type, degree standard, conducted by the Commission in online Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. The date will be intimated later. Appearance in all papers is compulsory; absence in any paper disqualifies the candidature. Computer Proficiency Test (CPT): candidates provisionally shortlisted after the written examination, in the ratio prescribed by the Commission, have to qualify the CPT. Minimum qualifying marks on aggregate: OC and EWS 40%, Backward Class 35%, SCs, STs and PBDs 30%. Securing the minimum marks does not confer any right to be considered for selection. If SC and ST candidates do not come up for selection with the minimum marks, their selection is considered on rank in the written examination irrespective of marks secured. Candidates with equal marks are ranked by age, oldest first; if age is also tied, the person with the earlier date of educational qualification is considered. After the final selection list, the marks list of successful candidates will be displayed on the Commission's website.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Each wrong answer is penalised with 1/3rd of the marks prescribed for the question. The General Studies and Mental Ability paper is set in English and translated into Telugu; the English version is authentic. Subject papers are in English only. If questions are deleted from a paper, scaling is done for that part of the paper and marks are rounded off to 2 decimals. If the Computer Based Tests are held in multiple sessions, the Commission will normalise scores and announce results on a percentile basis. The test is held at four centres: Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Tirupathi and Ananthapuramu. Candidates give three preferences, but the Commission may create any centre or allot any centre. Part-A is MCQ-based (20% of total marks). Part-B is a computer-based assessment: preparing a formatted model document including typing speed (25%), organising and inserting different objects (15%), preparing an Excel sheet (20%), and preparing a Power Point presentation (20%).

content_sections.heading: APPSC Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: Corrections in the application are enabled after the last date of submission and allowed up to 7 days from the last date of applications. The correction is made in the application form itself, with a payment of Rs. 100 per correction. Fields affecting Name, fee and age relaxation are not enabled for corrections, and no manual application for corrections is entertained. After this period, no changes (such as change of community or reservation category) are entertained.
